server_port.description: TCP port on which gkrellmd listens for client connections

server_enabled.description: Whether the gkrellmd server should be active

log_file.description: Path to log file. Use empty string to log to stderr

auth_required.description: Require username/password authentication for client connections

admins.description: List of usernames with full (admin) privileges

viewers.description: List of usernames with read-only (viewer) privileges

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for server connections

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file

ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for client verification (leave empty to disable client cert auth)

bind_hostname.description: Host/IP to bind to (empty string binds to all interfaces)

plugins.description: List of plugin modules to load (e.g., 'core' for built-in monitor)

disks.description: List of specific disk device names to monitor (empty = auto-detect all)

snmp_enabled.description: Enable SNMP monitoring of remote hosts

snmp_community.description: SNMP community string for read-only access

mail_recipients.description: List of email addresses to receive alerts
